title: Two-Factor Sunset (Code Expired)
style: vaporwave synthwave ballad, 80 bpm, lush DX7 chords, plastic Rhodes, gated reverb snare, deadpan female voice counting down digits, slow heartbreak melody, dial-up texture and modem ambience, sad pink-mall sunset mood, 336 hz subharmonic anchor under the bass, lo-fi tender
lyrics:
[Intro — soft Rhodes, voice counting]
(robotic) Six… nine… four… two… one… seven…
This code expires in thirty seconds…

[Verse 1]
I saw the digits, they were beautiful and true
I typed the first three, the fourth one I knew
I reached for the fifth, the digits all changed
The sunset on the screen, the love rearranged

[Pre-Chorus]
Thirty seconds was a lifetime, then it wasn't enough
The code expired before I could get my stuff

[Chorus]
Two-factor sunset, code expired again
I loved you for thirty seconds, then it ended at ten
Two-factor sunset, the digits walk away
Three-three-six in the timer, the codes don't stay

[Verse 2]
Resend the code, the new code is shorter
The new code expires twice as fast as it ought-er
I'm racing the clock to log into my life
My own account treats me like a stranger and a wife

[Chorus]
Two-factor sunset, code expired again
I loved you for thirty seconds, then it ended at ten
Two-factor sunset, the digits walk away
Three-three-six in the timer, the codes don't stay

[Outro]
(robotic) Code expired… please request a new code…
(beep)
